content.short: Gem Wallet is a community-owned, privacy-respecting open-source mobile crypto wallet for iOS and Android supporting Mantle Network.
content.description: Gem Wallet is an open-source, non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet built for iOS and Android that prioritizes user privacy and community governance above all else. The wallet collects zero user data, requires no account creation, and its full codebase is publicly auditable on GitHub. Gem supports Mantle Network alongside dozens of other blockchains, providing a clean and intuitive mobile interface for managing assets, sending transactions, and swapping tokens. Its community-owned model ensures the wallet's development is driven by user needs rather than commercial interests.
